properties.title: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Simulating Context-Aware Disease Trajectories

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: Latent treatment-conditioned MRI world model with a language-model therapy proposer and survival-aware iterative refinement, evaluated on glioma and breast cancer MRI cohorts.
Frozen MRI-CORE encoder with LoRA, a GPT-5 therapy policy agent, a text encoder, and an Actor that predicts post-treatment latents and survival risk, iterated K times to select a regimen.

properties.algorithm: Post-treatment latent transformer predictor with a cross-attention survival head trained with latent, contrastive, Brier and Cox losses

properties.population: patients with glioma or breast cancer who have longitudinal MRI

properties.description: MU-Glioma-Post, 203 patients and 654 MRI follow-ups, patient-level 75/15/15 split with 5-fold cross-validation
I-SPY 2 breast cancer MRI cohort, 985 patients, model trained separately
Regimen agreement metrics, survival C-index, ablations and a blinded two-expert assessment of 40 cases
properties.split_role: patient-level split plus zero-shot external cohort

properties.algorithm: MeWM-style diffusion predictor re-implemented on MRI

evidence_fragments.content: Keeping the encoder and survival head identical to ensure a fair comparison, we measure the cosine distance to the ground-truth post-treatment latent. As shown in Tab. 6, diffusion-based reconstruction leads to nearly 2× higher representation drift. This indicates that the intermediate pixel-generation step introduces substantial noise, whereas our direct latent prediction maintains the stability required for downstream survival evaluation.
The feedback loop (# 4 & 5) drives performance to a peak F1-score of 57.1% (# 5). This validates that iteratively refining therapies via survival feedback is essential for optimized decision-making.

capability_assessments.rationale: The full CLARITY system composes the Actor latent world model (model:A02:clarity-actor:v1, implementing persistent latent state, temporal transitions, and learned dynamics: 0019, 0041, 0042) with the GPT-5 Therapy Policy Agent in an iterative Inverse Survival Evaluation loop evaluated via regimen agreement, K=1..4 feedback ablations, and a blinded two-expert comparison on 40 cases (0063, 0120), supporting retrospective L4. Evidence remains offline/retrospective without counterfactual ground truth or prospective clinical outcome verification.

Downgraded standalone model:A02:clarity-actor:v1 from L4 to L3: the Actor (Diseases Evolution Model) implements persistent latent state and learned time- and therapy-conditioned dynamics (0019, 0041, 0042, 0043, 0053) and evaluates/compares alternative candidate regimens from the same pre-treatment latent z_pre in Direct Survival Evaluation (0039; Fig. 2, Table 4 #2-#3), whereas iterative L4 policy optimization (Inverse Survival Evaluation) requires the composed GPT-5 Therapy Policy Agent in system:A02:clarity:v1.

gate_assessments.rationale: A patient-level split and cross-validation are described, but the data used to choose K and loss weights is not stated.

Downgraded from pass to unresolved: although one-step post-treatment latent cosine drift (Table 6: 0.0084 vs 0.0174), decoded MRI probe metrics (Table 7: PSNR 27.91, SSIM 0.890, LPIPS 0.672), and survival C-index (0.794) are reported, non-leaky reference/split hygiene is unresolved (G01: stated 75%/15%/15% split sums to 105% and tuning split for K/loss weights is unstated), no acceptance tolerance is defined for latent drift, and state.persistent/dynamics.temporal lack standalone multi-step transition evaluation (G03 unresolved).
Multi-step rollouts run without intermediate imaging, so intermediate states are not validated.

legacy_cells.B: CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Simulating Context-Aware Disease Trajectories
legacy_cells.S: How candidate therapy schedules alter predicted latent disease states and survival risk for an MRI-imaged patient.
legacy_cells.T: MU-Glioma-Post: 203 patients; UCSF-ALPTDG: 298 patients; ISPY-2: 985 patients.
legacy_cells.V: Select a candidate treatment regimen or schedule with lower predicted survival risk.
legacy_cells.AI: 3D multi-sequence MRI; structured clinical variables; therapy descriptions; elapsed-time intervals
legacy_cells.AJ: MRI-CORE 12-layer ViT-B adapted with LoRA; MedGemma text encoder plus clinical MLP; pretrained text encoder for therapy descriptions; four-layer self-attention Transformer transition and four-layer bidirectional cross-attention survival predictor
legacy_cells.AM: Concatenation of pre-treatment visual latent, clinical embedding, elapsed-time embedding and therapy embedding
legacy_cells.AZ: Auxiliary diffusion decoder probes predicted latents; qualitative MRI visualizations and reported reconstruction/perceptual measures are used to inspect anatomy and pathology representation.
legacy_cells.BA: Latent consistency loss: L1 distance between predicted and ground-truth post-treatment latent states.
legacy_cells.BD: Therapy components include chemotherapy, external radiotherapy, brachytherapy, immunotherapy and supportive strategies; generated descriptions specify drug type, dose and schedule.
legacy_cells.BF: Rules prohibit specified incompatible drug pairs; dose/cycle and radiation dose/fraction ranges are constrained; history-aware rules prevent conflicting repeated modalities.
legacy_cells.BL: Elapsed interval Δt = tpost − tpre; transitions also use arbitrary discrete time points, with no fixed step size reported.
legacy_cells.BS: Predicted post-treatment latent state; one-year survival probability; continuous survival risk score. An auxiliary decoder maps predicted latents to MRI for analysis.
legacy_cells.BT: Post-treatment latent predictor; survival predictor producing one-year survival probability and continuous risk score.
legacy_cells.BU: Cumulative discounted predicted survival risk J over a treatment trajectory; maximizes negative expected J plus an entropy term τH(q).
legacy_cells.BV: Weighted total objective combines latent L1 consistency, soft contrastive treatment-similarity loss, one-year Brier loss and Cox partial-likelihood loss.
legacy_cells.DQ: MU-Glioma-Post: 203 patients and 654 MRI follow-ups; UCSF-ALPTDG: 298 patients; ISPY-2: 985 patients.
legacy_cells.EC: Blinded expert comparison on 40 held-out cases: CLARITY recommendation rated equivalent/non-inferior in 60.0%, preferred in 35.0%, and physician regimen preferred in 5.0%.
legacy_cells.EE: Blinded assessment on 40 held-out cases: two candidate regimens (CLARITY recommendation and physician-administered regimen) were compared; raters could mark one preferred or clinically equivalent.
legacy_cells.EG: Latent simulation: 4.21 TFLOPs and 0.341 s; diffusion baselines required up to 61.3 TFLOPs and 38.6 s for a simulation.
legacy_cells.EJ: Compared with the MeWM-style diffusion predictor (MeWM*); paper text reports F1 57.1% for CLARITY versus 43.6% for MeWM* on MU-Glioma-Post.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablated latent versus diffusion dynamics, clinical context, inverse-survival feedback, iteration count K, loss combinations and visual encoders.
legacy_cells.EL: At K=4 performance slightly declined; authors state excessive iterations may introduce noise and report diminishing returns.
legacy_cells.EM: Guideline-informed candidate prompts; incompatible-regimen restrictions; dose/cycle and radiation ranges; history-aware therapy constraints.
legacy_cells.FB: A 768-dimensional MRI-derived visual latent zpre is the initial disease state; clinical, elapsed-time and therapy embeddings condition state transitions.
legacy_cells.FL: MRI-CORE ViT-B encoder adapted with LoRA yields a 768-dimensional visual state; clinical and therapy text embeddings plus elapsed-time embedding condition a Transformer latent transition; predicted post-treatment latent feeds cross-attention survival/risk heads; GPT-5 therapy-policy agent proposes regimens, receives predicted-risk feedback and iteratively refines candidates.
legacy_cells.FM: Authors contribute treatment-conditioned latent disease transitions; explicit temporal and patient-clinical conditioning; and inverse-survival evaluation integrating imagined rollouts with iterative therapy proposal refinement.
legacy_cells.FN: Reported: C-index 0.794 on MU-Glioma-Post; treatment-exploration F1 57.1% on MU-Glioma-Post; expert comparison on 40 cases rated 60.0% equivalent/non-inferior, 35.0% CLARITY-preferred and 5.0% physician-preferred; latent simulation 0.341 s and 4.21 TFLOPs.
legacy_cells.FO: Authors note need for multi-institutional validation across unseen centers/protocols; MRI dependence and need for representation realignment/retraining for other modalities such as CT; and risk that incomplete medical-rule constraints produce suboptimal or miss novel/off-label therapies.
legacy_cells.FQ: Authors argue existing medical generative methods focus on pixel-space synthesis or single future states and lack explicit treatment-conditioned latent dynamics integrated with long-horizon therapy planning.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence is retrospective and model-based; treatment conditioning and simulated alternative regimens do not establish causal treatment effects or identified counterfactuals. Expert review is not prospective clinical benefit; the paper reports no prospective clinical study or deployment.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer; M8 Planner; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Keep the learned patient/scene simulator separate from the planner objective; constrain candidate actions and report closed-loop decision quality alongside model fidelity.

notes: CLARITY encodes a pre-treatment MRI with a LoRA-adapted foundation model and uses an Actor transformer conditioned on clinical context, time gap and a therapy embedding to predict post-treatment latents and survival risk. A GPT-5 agent proposes regimens and receives risk feedback for K iterations.
